purpose: Discriminate receiving-state structure from local parameter and Adam update registration on one surviving matched-prestate counterexample.

transplant_semantics.parameter: Add the donor's named native parameter delta to the recipient prestate parameter with the same identity.
transplant_semantics.optimizer: Add the donor's named native Adam step, exp_avg and exp_avg_sq deltas to the recipient prestate optimizer state with the same identity.
transplant_semantics.joint: Apply both donor delta families to the same recipient prestate.

adjudication.response_comparison: Compare branch-minus-skip response tensors, not absolute poststates.
adjudication.update_dominant: Both reciprocal donor responses are closer to donor-native than recipient-native response signatures at the relevant horizons.
adjudication.receiving_state_dominant: Both reciprocal donor responses remain closer to recipient-native than donor-native response signatures.
adjudication.delayed_optimizer_dominant: Parameter-donor responses follow the donor at horizon 1 while optimizer or joint donor responses become donor-like only at later horizons.
